vb_textbox.text: There initially appears to be no pattern to the reward (higher mushrooms). I seemed to find that alternating between left and right gnomes resulted in a higher average number of mushrooms - this may not be accurate though. When I focussed on one gnome in particular (ie. just left or right repeatedly( the numbers of mushrooms as rewards appeared to increase steadily. Once the number dropped down to one or zero, I found that swapping to the other gnome helped build the number of rewards again. Good luck!
